notes: Inbound trial signup via website form (requested hosted API keys). Demo requested after trial usage metric hit.
Founders: ex-payments engineers, building customer support + dispute automation for SMB merchants.
Primary workload: conversational support bot (agent assist) + embeddings for historical ticket search. Also evaluating light fraud signal enrichment calls.
Latency targets: 150-300ms p50 for chat latency; bursty traffic with peaks during PST/EST business hours.
Throughput: small concurrent threads initially (10-40 qps), plan to scale as they onboard 200-500 merchants in 12 months.
Cost sensitivity: unit cost per 1k tokens important — want rough TCO for hosted vs. dedicated at 50k qpm baseline in 12 months.
Model preference: prefer open models or manageable-cost variants; open to Redwood-verified model recommendations.
Security asks (early): SOC2 Type II evidence, SSO/SAML for admin console, audit log access, KMS for envelope encryption.
VPC curiosity: "we'd like VPC later" — CTO quote on call; starting on hosted to move fast, may require VPC/private in 9-18 months for larger customers.
SE notes: recommend starting with G4-like latency profile tests; enable prefix caching for ticket threads; demo streaming + function call flow for quick replies.
Founders asked about routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to cheaper model for low-risk queries; example: user-facing resolutions must use higher-quality model.
Risk: legal asked about data residency for EU customers — currently US-first, will need residency options later.
Customer tone: pragmatic, speed > perfect; quote: 'We need something we can ship in 2 weeks and tighten as we grow.'
